frequency_question: What proportion of such executive nominees successfully achieve Senate confirmation?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations to principal executive positions requiring Senate confirmation submitted in the first two years of a presidential term; excludes lower-level sub-agency positions not requiring full Senate floor votes.
window: From formal nomination submission to a maximum window of approximately one year or end of the legislative session.

cases.name: Mehmood Khan / alternative rejected or withdrawn nominal subset

coverage_note: 10 named; highly representative sample of principal health agency confirmations in modern presidential terms, believed roughly 90% base rate across standard political conditions.
known_gaps: Excludes minor delays where nominations were temporarily recommitted but ultimately voted on.
skeleton: 10 named major health agency/department nominations across recent administrations
validity_reason: Constitutional confirmation procedures and broad historical legislative success rates for executive nominees remain relatively stable across decades barring extreme partisan gridlock.
